package.description: Share files between your Windows host and Wasabi hot cloud storage

en-US.description: Share files between your Windows host and Wasabi hot cloud storage
en-US.longDescription:
Wasabi Explorer is a free app that enables you to share files between your Windows host and the Wasabi hot cloud storage service. This app is a version of CloudBerry Explorer from MSP360 that has been customized for use with Wasabi hot cloud storage. Wasabi Explorer provides a user interface to your Wasabi storage account by allowing you to access, move and manage files across your local storage and your Wasabi storage buckets. Features include:
- Familiar Windows File Explorer-like user interface
- Compression and encryption
- Ability to access multiple Wasabi storage regions
- Upload rules
- Header editing
- Multi-part uploads
en-US.name: Wasabi Explorer for Cloud Storage

zh-CN.description: 在您的 Windows 主机与 Wasabi 热云存储之间共享文件
zh-CN.longDescription:
Wasabi Explorer 是一款免费应用程序，可帮助您在 Windows 主机与 Wasabi 热云存储服务之间共享文件。该应用是基于 MSP360 的 CloudBerry Explorer 专为 Wasabi 热云存储定制的版本，通过直观界面让您能在本地存储与 Wasabi 存储桶之间访问、转移和管理文件。主要功能包括：
- 类 Windows 文件资源管理器的熟悉界面
- 文件压缩与加密功能
- 支持访问多个 Wasabi 存储区域
- 上传规则设定
- 文件头信息编辑
- 多分块上传支持
